targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, count() AS calls FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='model.call' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])) AS input, sum(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])) AS output FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name']='model.call' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time, LogAttributes['event.name'] AS kind, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] IN ('gateway.denied','egress.denied','dns.denied') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY time, kind ORDER BY time
SELECT LogAttributes['event.name'] AS event, count() AS n FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY event ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT Timestamp, ServiceName, LogAttributes['event.name'] AS event, LogAttributes['message'] AS message, ResourceAttributes['agentbox.user'] AS user FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE SeverityText IN ('WARN','ERROR') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
